description: Hivemind grants notification access, one read-only app-version command, and the six window commands its own title bar needs. Update discovery and installation are custom Rust commands; every updater plugin IPC command is explicitly denied so the webview cannot bypass the on-disk idleness gate. The window permissions were added when `decorations: false` made this app draw its own caption: without them the webview could not move, maximise or close its own window, which was measured -- every call answered "not allowed by ACL" and the window was unmovable. They are the narrowest set that makes a title bar work and reach nothing outside the window itself: no filesystem, no shell, no other window.
